qrFetchFailed: Could not get the QR code: {reason}
qrVerifyRejected: The sign-in did not verify. Refresh the QR code and scan again.

qrScanned: Scanned. Confirm the sign-in on your phone.

cookieTip.douyu: Sign in to www.douyu.com in a desktop browser, copy the Cookie request header from the developer tools and paste it below. To allow renewal, also paste the cookie of a passport.douyu.com request (with LTP0); the app keeps LTP0 and dy_did from it.
cookieTip.twitch: Sign in to twitch.tv in a desktop browser and copy the cookie. Only its auth-token is used, for subscriber-only streams and no ads.
cookieTip.soop: Sign in to sooplive.co.kr in a desktop browser and copy the cookie. It is only sent with stream requests for 19+ streams.
cookieTip.other: Sign in to the platform's website in a desktop browser, copy the Cookie request header from the developer tools and paste it below.

cookieSavedRejoin: Saved. It applies when you reopen the room.
cookieHidden: The saved cookie is not shown; pasting a new one replaces it
keptIfEmpty: Saved; leave empty to keep it
douyuKeysSaved: Saved LTP0 and dy_did for renewal
passportKept: This is a passport cookie: LTP0 and dy_did are saved and the current sign-in is kept
passportNeedsLogin: This is a passport cookie: LTP0 and dy_did are saved. Paste the cookie of a www.douyu.com page too to sign in.
noLoginKept: The pasted cookie has no sign-in; the current sign-in is kept
renewMissingKeys: LTP0 or dy_did is missing, so it cannot be renewed
renewNoLogin: The cookie has no sign-in, so it cannot be renewed
renewNoResult: Douyu returned no new sign-in; nothing was renewed
signOutBody: The sign-in saved on this device will be deleted.
signOutBodyBrowser: The sign-in saved on this device will be deleted, and the built-in browser will be signed out.
qrSignIn: Sign in with a QR code
qrSignInSubtitle: Scan with the Bilibili mobile app
webSignInSubtitle: Sign in with a password or text message in the built-in browser
storageNoteFull: Sign-in data is encrypted with this device's system key, never uploaded and never shown in the app or logs; it is left out of backups by default.
webReadFailed: Could not read the sign-in. Sign in again.
webNoCookie: No sign-in was found. Sign in again.
webRejected: The sign-in did not verify. Sign in again.
webUnavailable: Web sign-in is not available here
webUnavailableHint: Sign in with a QR code or enter a cookie instead.
